prompt_section: ## 2. CHARACTER A — Frontend Developer — exact final prompt
prompt_suffix: IDENTITY — this is the SAME approved person shown in reference #1 (the Frontend Developer master). Preserve his exact identity, do NOT redesign: same face and facial structure, same short tousled near-black hair (#2B2B3A) with side-swept fringe, same light-medium skin (#F2C9A0), no facial hair, same charcoal-navy zip hoodie over a plain tee, same slim dark jeans and sneakers, same over-ear headphones resting around the neck, same readable blue accent (#5B8CFF), same slim medium build, same age and creative-focused-energetic personality. He must remain immediately recognizable as the SAME character — only the POSE changes. STATE = REVIEWING: standing near the Frontend workstation, body turned 3/4 isometric toward the monitors, holding a small tablet / review device in one hand and reviewing a web UI on it, the other hand interacting naturally or resting, a thoughtful focused expression, a slight natural lean toward the workstation. The action must read as 'reviewing UI / checking frontend work' WITHOUT any text label. NOT a front-facing portrait, NOT a seated coding pose, NOT a dramatic action pose, NOT a plain idle stand. CAMERA: true 3/4 top-down ISOMETRIC, body turned about 30 to 45 degrees, slight top-down so the top plane of shoulders/head shows, feet aligned to the isometric floor direction — not front-facing, not profile, not a flat sticker. STYLE: the SAME fine pixel density, thin selective outlines, 3-tone shading and soft ambient occlusion as the IT/Dev floor (reference #2). LIGHTING: warm key light from the upper-left, softer darker shading lower-right, a subtle cyan monitor rim light, gentle ambient occlusion. Standalone single character, fully TRANSPARENT background — NO room, NO floor, NO desk, NO chair, no ground or shadow plate, no scenery, no UI, no text, no logo, no watermark, full body with nothing cropped. REFERENCE PRIORITY: reference #1 (approved character master) controls IDENTITY and must be preserved exactly; reference #2 (IT/Dev floor) controls perspective, pixel density, lighting and environment compatibility; reference #3 (AI office image) controls the general game-art direction.
